settlement.instructions: The settle response must put decisions, credited_facts, commitments, and justification_fact_ids inside the settlement object. Use the exact required facts and schedule values. Bare times and date-qualified times are both acceptable for schedule fields.

commitments.detail: Maya must be present to start, stop, and monitor the generator during every scheduled operating period.
A different family member must be responsible for starting, stopping, and monitoring the generator during each of the scheduled operating periods.
